body:
🌍 Cobblemon SMP — Adventure Awaits!
Jump into a cozy modded SMP focused on Cobblemon gameplay. Catch, train, evolve, battle, trade, and build with the squad as we explore a fresh world together.
No more hardcore mode — the server is now fully survival-friendly so you can enjoy long-term progression without losing everything.

✨ Features:
• Pokémon-style catching & battling
• Team exploration & base building
• Trading, tournaments, and friendly rivalries
• Long-term world, no hardcore reset
• Just good vibes with the homies
